name: Fueng Fah Riverside / Mueang Kaeo leisure edge
notes: Small riverfront leisure catchment anchored by Fueng Fah Riverside Gardens Resort, its restaurant, and nearby flower-garden visits. Demand is primarily overnight and seasonal; it must not inherit the Route 107 corridor pool or be treated as a mall-scale destination.

name: Chai Sathan Lom Nam residential and school edge
notes: Residential edge beside Chongfah Sinseung Wanichbumrung School and approximately 1 km from Ring 3 / Highway 11 access. Supports local weekday trips but is not a retail destination or highway-frontage demand pool.

name: Chiang Mai Airport / Central Airport frontage
notes: Airport-adjacent frontage covering terminal access, ride-hailing pickup, rental-car turnover, and Central Airport spillover. The field is intentionally tight so airport activity does not inflate the Doi Suthep side.

name: Mahidol east medical and urban service corridor
notes: Mahidol corridor east of Central Airport, supported by Central Memorial and Rajavej hospitals plus through-traffic and commercial service trips. This retains a continuous but narrower demand band along Mahidol rather than concentrating all airport-side demand at the terminal.

name: Chiang Mai Ring 2 west-southwest urban fringe
notes: Ring 2 / Chom.3029 stretch covering Mae Hia, early Hang Dong, and canal-road frontage. It is a secondary suburban retail field, not a city-scale demand pool.

name: Chiang Mai Ring 2 north-northeast urban fringe
notes: Ring 2 / Chom.3029 stretch covering Fa Ham, Nong Chom, San Sai edge, and community retail growth along the urban fringe.

name: Chiang Mai Ring 2 east-southeast urban fringe
notes: Ring 2 / Chom.3029 stretch covering inner San Kamphaeng and Saraphi spillover where city activity blends with suburban housing and roadside retail.

name: Chiang Mai Ring 3 south-southeast connector
notes: Highway 121 outer-ring section linking Hang Dong, Saraphi, and south-side cross-town trips without entering the inner city. The radius is limited to the connector and does not act as a proxy for Hang Dong retail demand.

name: Chiang Mai Ring 3 east connector
notes: Highway 121 outer-ring east side connecting Doi Saket, San Kamphaeng, and Lampang-side flow. Radius is kept tighter to the actual ring-road connector rather than broad east-side spillover.

name: Chiang Mai Ring 3 north connector
notes: Highway 121 outer-ring north side linking San Sai, Mae Rim directions, and inter-district traffic that bypasses the inner city. Radius is restrained to the mapped Ring 3 connector and does not extend into the Mueang Kaeo riverside local-road catchment.

name: The Kad Farang Mae Rim retail cluster
notes: Retail-and-dining node on Route 107 in Mae Rim anchored by The Kad Farang Mae Rim, Rimping, Starbucks, and convenience retail. Treat as a destination/community-commercial stop rather than generic northbound corridor flow.
